config.document: string _id item-%08d, name, qty, price, category, 128-byte payload; one collection, _id index only

environment.write_concern: seed and measured native writes: majority
environment.timing: monotonic wall clock around whole CLI processes and driver calls; no warm-up discarded; one workflow at a time
environment.isolation: shared developer host; background load is not controlled

argon.binary: bin/argon-bin, the executable the npm launcher starts

runner.network: shares the MongoDB container's network namespace; MongoDB is reached at localhost:27017
